title: Test environment
settingsDescription: Define how to install, build and start this project. Each agent gets an isolated environment from its current files, including uncommitted changes.
setupRequired: An administrator must enable the service: approved images, wildcard domain, HTTPS certificate and proxy routing. No test application port is published on the host.
enable: Allow test environments for this project
directory: Project directory (relative to the agent’s working copy)
hotHelp: Sources are checked every two seconds. In hot mode, Vite and compatible servers reload changes through WebSocket. Otherwise, use process restart and refresh the page. Dependency changes may require recreating the environment.
advanced: Advanced configuration: test variables and services
services: Supporting services (JSON array: name, runtime, command, env)
secretsHelp: Use test accounts and data only. Values are encrypted at rest and hidden after saving; keep [stored] to retain an existing value. Server application cookies are isolated; reading cookies directly from JavaScript may require adaptation.
isolationHelp: No Docker socket, system files, private network or production accounts. Common sensitive files and dependencies are excluded from the copy. Test volumes and databases are ephemeral and deleted on stop or expiry.
saved: Profile saved. Recreate any running environment to apply its new configuration.
description: Test this agent’s changes at a direct URL in your normal browser. Access is personal and project-scoped; no Codex account or production secret is copied automatically.
dependenciesChanged: Dependencies changed. Recreate the environment to run installation and build again.
recreateConfirm: Recreate this environment from the current files? Its ephemeral test data will be deleted, never the agent’s sources.
stopConfirm: Stop this environment and delete its ephemeral test data? The agent’s sources remain intact.
popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the window. Allow popups for Mergeron and try again.
